title: Reimbursed Days on a Paper Claim by Place of Purchase — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Clause.** The reimbursed days of a paper claim under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit depend on where the fill was bought:

- for a purchase made outside the United States, they are the receipt's days supply limited to the network's maximum days supply per retail fill;
- for an out-of-network fill in the United States on a network whose out-of-network coverage is emergency only, they are the receipt's days supply limited to the network's maximum days supply for an emergency out-of-network fill;
- for any other fill, they are the receipt's days supply.

"Limited to" means the lesser of the receipt's days supply and the figure named. Where the fill was bought is read from the paper-claim submission: whether it records a purchase outside the United States, and the network status of the pharmacy on the receipt (preferred, standard network or out of network).

## Schedule of the figures

| Network | Maximum days supply per retail fill | Out-of-network coverage | Maximum days supply for an emergency out-of-network fill |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 30 | Emergency only | 10 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 30 | Emergency only | 10 |
| Northbridge National Network | 34 | Emergency only | 14 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 34 | Emergency only | 14 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 90 | Emergency only | 14 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 90 | Covered with penalty | 30 |

## Applied to hypothetical receipts

| Receipt | Network | Reimbursed days |
|---|---|---|
| 45 days, bought outside the United States | Northbridge National Network | 34 |
| 30 days, bought outside the United States | Northbridge Retail90 Network | 30 |
| 30 days, out-of-network pharmacy in the United States | Northbridge Performance Network | 10 |
| 12 days, out-of-network pharmacy in the United States | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 12 |
| 45 days, out-of-network pharmacy in the United States | Northbridge Open Choice Network | 45, because that network's out-of-network coverage is not emergency only |
| 60 days, network pharmacy | any network | 60 |

A purchase outside the United States is limited by the per-fill maximum, not by the emergency out-of-network maximum, whichever network the member is on.
